name: Stellary
description: Connect AI assistants to Stellary projects, boards, documents, and governed agent workflows.

inputs.label: Stellary Personal Access Token
inputs.description: PAT sent as a Bearer token to the hosted Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Required for any useful call.

obtain.instructions:
1. Sign in at app.stellary.co
2. Open Account settings → API tokens from the user menu
3. Create a personal access token (start with projects:read and pilotage:read; add write scopes only if needed)
4. Copy the plaintext secret shown once at creation

auth.instructions: Create a Stellary personal access token in Account settings → API tokens and send it as an Authorization: Bearer header. This listing uses Bearer PAT, not OAuth.
